headline: Strategic Base Fighting Intensifies Across Divided Sectors
war_summary: The latest watch finds strategic movement shifting sharply since the previous edition. Weathered Expanse has surged from five daily events to 18, including nine in the latest two hours; its ledger remains divided, seven Warden bases to one Colonial and one neutral. Lykos Isle has climbed to 21 daily events, with three recent, while retaining seven Colonial bases throughout. Stlican Shelf now records 12 daily events, seven in six hours, and remains closely split at five Warden to four Colonial. Oarbreaker has seven events on the day and three in the latest two hours, with seven Colonial bases against two Warden. Fisherman’s Row remains a chief arena despite easing slightly to 33 daily events; two occurred in the latest two-hour watch, and its balance is seven Warden bases to two Colonial. Godcrofts has become a fresh late-hour disturbance, logging five events in two hours and six in the day, with eight Warden bases, one neutral, and no Colonial holdings. Tempest Island remains active by the day’s count but has gone quiet in the latest two-hour window.
